name: Orchard Keeper Mabel

intro.text: Cox, Bramley, Russet, and a little tree at the back nobody can name. Pick one. No, not the little one.

win: Ooh, you've a fair bit of crunch to you.
after: In January we wassail the trees: toast in the branches, cider at the roots, and a lot of shouting to wake them up for spring.
